the free amino acids of Juniperus are important in the pollen tube growth and in the cellular development of pollen tubes.
the amino acid composition of the ovule is a good indicator of the pollen tube growth in vitro.
the amino acid composition of the ovule is complementary to that of the pollen.

the pollen tube growth in vitro is not only dependent on the presence of amino acids, but also on their nature and concentration.
